list.title: Arrivals
list.hint: Each arrival is a contractor's cargo that reached the dock. Register the arrival, check the invoices and separate by route and city before building the trip.

register.title: Register arrival
register.hint: Pick the contractor, say when the truck arrived and tick the invoices that came. The separation window starts at the arrival time.
register.contractorHint: Only contractors with receiving turned on in their profile are listed.
register.contractorEmpty: No contractor with receiving turned on
register.timeHint: Default: now, in your browser's time zone.
register.referenceHint: Seal or cargo number, up to {{max}} characters.

available.title: Cargo invoices
available.pickContractor: Pick the contractor to list their free invoices.
available.empty: This contractor has no free invoices for an arrival.
available.limitReached: The limit of {{max}} invoices per arrival was reached.

issues.future: The arrival cannot be in the future.
issues.integer: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

errors.CARGO_RECEIVING_NOT_ENABLED: Cargo receiving is not turned on for this contractor. Turn it on in their profile, under Clients, Contractors tab.
errors.CARGO_ARRIVAL_ARRIVED_AT_IN_FUTURE: The arrival cannot be in the future. Check the date and time.
errors.CARGO_ARRIVAL_KEY_REUSED: This attempt was already used with other data. Check and register again.
errors.CARGO_ARRIVAL_CLOSED: The arrival is closed: read only.

detail.title: Arrival of {{name}}
detail.openSeparation: Open the separation on the phone

actions.routeHint: Leave empty to clear the route of the selected invoices.

outcome.title: Batch result
outcome.routeApplied: Route applied to the selected invoices.

separation.title: Separation
separation.scanDenied: The camera was denied. Allow access in the browser settings.
separation.scanReading: Point the camera at the invoice barcode.
separation.scanUnavailable: This device cannot read with the camera.
separation.scanNotFound: This key does not belong to any invoice of this arrival.
separation.offline: No connection. A tap that fails stays on screen to try again.

failure.PREVIEW_CELL_TOO_LONG: A spreadsheet cell is longer than allowed.
failure.PREVIEW_COLUMN_DUPLICATED: The spreadsheet header repeats a column.
failure.PREVIEW_COLUMN_NOT_FOUND: A column the contractor profile expects is missing from the spreadsheet.
failure.PREVIEW_FILE_CORRUPTED: The file is corrupted and could not be read.
failure.PREVIEW_FILE_MISSING: The uploaded file was not found for reading.
failure.PREVIEW_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The spreadsheet is larger than allowed.
failure.PREVIEW_MATCH_TIMEOUT: Linking this preview to the invoices took longer than allowed. Send the same file again to retry.
failure.PREVIEW_NOT_A_WORKBOOK: The file is not a valid .xlsx or .xlsm spreadsheet.
failure.PREVIEW_NOT_ENABLED: Previews are not enabled for this contractor.
failure.PREVIEW_PARSE_TIMEOUT: Reading the spreadsheet took longer than the limit.
failure.PREVIEW_PROCESSING_ABANDONED: Reading the spreadsheet did not finish. Send the same file again to retry.
failure.PREVIEW_PROCESSING_INTERRUPTED: Reading the spreadsheet was interrupted midway. Send the same file again to retry.
failure.PREVIEW_SHEET_NOT_FOUND: The sheet set in the profile does not exist in the spreadsheet.
failure.PREVIEW_TOO_MANY_CELLS: The spreadsheet has too many cells, in a row or in total.
failure.PREVIEW_TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: The file has too many entries to be a spreadsheet.
failure.PREVIEW_TOO_MANY_ROWS: The spreadsheet has too many rows.
failure.PREVIEW_TOO_MANY_STRINGS: The spreadsheet has too many texts.
failure.PREVIEW_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE: A number in the spreadsheet is too large to be stored. Check the values and weights.
failure.PREVIEW_ZIP_BOMB: The file expands beyond the safety limit.
failure.PREVIEW_ZIP_ENTRY_UNSAFE: The file has an unsafe entry and was refused.
failure.unknown: The spreadsheet could not be read. Check the file and upload it again.

list.title: Previews
list.hint: Each preview is the spreadsheet the contractor sends before the cargo arrives. Upload it, check what already has an invoice and propose the arrival.

upload.title: Upload spreadsheet
upload.contractorHint: Only contractors with receiving and previews turned on in the profile appear.
upload.contractorEmpty: No contractor with receiving and previews turned on
upload.fileHint: Accepts .xlsx and .xlsm up to {{max}} KB. Reading happens in the background.
upload.noEligibleContractor: No contractor with previews turned on. Turn on receiving and previews in the contractor profile, in Clients, Contractors tab.

file.tooLarge: The spreadsheet is over {{max}} KB. Upload one up to {{max}} KB.

errors.PREVIEW_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The spreadsheet is over the 960 KB limit the server accepts.
errors.PREVIEW_NOT_A_WORKBOOK: The file is not a valid .xlsx or .xlsm spreadsheet.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_NOT_ENABLED: Previews are not enabled for this contractor. Turn them on in its profile, in Clients, Contractors tab.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_TOO_MANY_OPEN: This contractor already has 5 previews waiting to be read. Wait for them to finish and upload again.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_KEY_REUSED: This attempt was already used with another spreadsheet. Choose the file again and upload.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This row is no longer part of the preview.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_NOT_READY: The preview was not read yet. Wait for the reading to finish.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_DOCUMENT_ALREADY_LINKED: This invoice is already linked to another preview.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_DOCUMENT_NOT_CANDIDATE: This invoice cannot be linked to this preview: it is from another issuer or not authorized.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_ITEM_ALREADY_LINKED: This row is already linked to another invoice. Unlink it before linking again.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_ITEM_NOT_SUGGESTED: Only a row with a suggestion can be confirmed.
errors.CARGO_PREVIEW_ITEM_INVALID: This row is invalid in the spreadsheet: there is nothing to link. Fix the spreadsheet and upload it again.

detail.title: Preview of {{name}}
detail.awaitingNote: Waiting for the XML is normal: the preview arrives hours before the invoices. The link is made when each XML is imported.

rowErrors.decimal: the value must be a decimal number, not negative

manual.title: Link row {{row}} to an invoice
manual.empty: No free invoice from this contractor matches the search.

proposal.title: Arrival draft
proposal.none: No invoice can go into the arrival right now.
proposal.register: Register the arrival with these invoices
proposal.noMatched: No invoice linked yet: invoices come in when the XML arrives.
proposal.notReady: The preview is still being read.
proposal.failed: Reading the preview failed: fix the spreadsheet and upload it again.

prefill.notice_one: {{count}} invoice came from the preview. Check the arrival date and time: they are not assumed.
prefill.notice_other: {{count}} invoices came from the preview. Check the arrival date and time: they are not assumed.
prefill.missing_one: {{count}} proposed invoice is no longer free and was left out.
prefill.missing_other: {{count}} proposed invoices are no longer free and were left out.

drafts.title: Trip recommendation
drafts.hint: The contractor's routes become draft trips and the route optimizer makes its own proposal. Nothing becomes a trip without your approval.
drafts.error: The trip recommendation could not be loaded.
drafts.notReady: The recommendation shows up once the preview has been read.
drafts.failed: Reading the preview failed: there is nothing to recommend.
drafts.empty: This preview has no routes to recommend.
drafts.readOnly: You can see the recommendation; building trips needs the trips permission.

routes.title: Contractor routes
routes.hint: Each route in the spreadsheet is a draft trip with the invoices already linked.

card.missing_other: {{count}} invoices missing — waiting for the XML
card.inLiveTrip_one: {{count}} invoice is already on a trip
card.inLiveTrip_other: {{count}} invoices are already on a trip
card.create: Build a trip with these invoices
card.chooseRoute: Use only this route in the proposal

reason.no_linked_documents: No invoice linked yet: the trip can be built once the XML arrives.
reason.none_routable: The linked invoices are already on a trip or cannot be routed.

outside.suggested_other: {{count}} suggested lines waiting for your approval
outside.ambiguous_one: {{count}} ambiguous line, for you to pick the invoice
outside.ambiguous_other: {{count}} ambiguous lines, for you to pick the invoice
